label: Concept Environment
description: A production concept painting: one location established with scale, mood and a story beat, painted loose where it can be and tight where it matters.
prefix: A production concept painting of an environment, establishing scale and mood in one image
suffix: painted as concept art: confident value structure read before colour, a small human-scale element establishing size, loose brushwork in the periphery and resolved detail at the focus
negative: flat lighting, no focal point, snapshot framing, watermark, signature, text artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers
